title: finding(build): six plugin vite.configs carry alias and globals rows for packages the plugin never imports
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8198 (the unused-dependency gate). Not repaired there: that card's licence was the gate plus manifest keys with no consumer, and a `vite.config.ts` is neither.

## Measured

Six plugin `vite.config.ts` files carry `resolve.alias` and/or `rollupOptions.output.globals` rows naming a package that no file under the plugin's `src/` imports. An alias only rewrites a specifier somebody writes, and a `globals` row only names an external somebody imports, so a row for an unimported package does nothing at all. Measured on `e2409120f`:

| config | row naming a package the plugin does not import |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/plugin-ai/vite.config.ts` | `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/fields`, `react-dom` |
| `packages/plugin-editor/vite.config.ts` | `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/fields`, `react-dom` |
| `packages/plugin-markdown/vite.config.ts` | `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/fields`, `react-dom` |
| `packages/plugin-designer/vite.config.ts` | `@object-ui/fields`, `react-dom` |
| `packages/plugin-map/vite.config.ts` | `lucide-react`, `react-dom` |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/vite.config.ts` | `react-dom` |

Reproduce with, for each pair, `grep -q "'NAME':" packages/PKG/vite.config.ts` and `grep -rqF "from 'NAME'" packages/PKG/src` — the second finds nothing.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

These configs are copied from one another when a plugin is created, so the rows propagate. Two concrete costs:

- **They read as documentation and are wrong.** objectui#8198 spent real time confirming that `@object-ui/react` in `plugin-ai`'s manifest was genuinely unused, precisely because the alias row looked like evidence of a consumer. It was not.
- **`react-dom` is the interesting one.** Every plugin externalises it and maps it to a `ReactDOM` global; none imports it. Whether that is right depends on objectui#8300 (the `react-dom` peer convention), so this card should probably be decided after that one.

## Scope note

This is an observation, not a defect with a user-visible symptom: the builds are correct today and removing the rows changes no output. It is listed so the cleanup is a decision rather than an oversight.

Filed unassigned by the objectui#8198 implementation session.
